source_gaps: R31-STOP-MOTION-PROCEDURAL-CON-MICROJITTER-D: no primary source found for the exact deterministic hash-plus-bounded-jitter construction; keep it labeled as an authored procedural rule.

R31-MODELO-DE-DISPERSI-N-MICROFACET-PARA-CAB: source supports the BCSDF family, but full article equations/lobes still require transcription before implementation.
R31-KUWAHARA-ANISOTR-PICO-MULTIESCALA: primary paper located; exact sector weights, scale fusion and parameter conventions still need transcription.
R31-RUIDO-DE-EROSI-N-ORIENTADO-POR-FLUJO-Y-P: source supports structured Phasor noise aligned with slope/flow; original formula is a schematic abstraction, not the paper's full formulation.

R31-SDF-SMOOTH-UNION-Y-MODELADO-IMPL-CITO: primary mathematical source for the exact polynomial smooth-min variant and Lipschitz/sphere-tracing bounds still needs final selection; do not treat all smooth-min variants as equivalent.
R31-ADVECCI-N-SEMI-LAGRANGIANA-DE-PIGMENTO: DiVerdi et al. supports procedural pigment advection, but exact backtrace, diffusion and drying discretization require full-text review.
R31-DUAL-CONTOURING: source supports Hermite data and QEF; exact regularization and robust topology policy remain implementation decisions requiring explicit tests.
audit_notes: A cited paper's abstract may support the topic but not every formula or implementation detail.
No source has been used to silently replace existing equations or pseudocode.
Hair BCSDF is intentionally not reconstructed from a schematic proportionality expression.
The matrix's 13 passed tests are isolated numeric kernels, not proof of browser rendering.
Added source records for spatial hashing, periodic halftoning, hatching, depth/normal edges, brush height fields, volumetric Beer-Lambert integration, RK methods and Schlick Fresnel.
Source coverage is improved but not complete at formula-transcription level for all 23 records. A topic-level paper reference is not evidence for every coefficient or implementation convention.
Greedy meshing currently has a primary implementation source, not a peer-reviewed paper.

2026-11-27 formula-level pass: opened the full FABRIK paper PDF and verified Algorithm 1 plus Section 4 locators; opened the full Kavan et al. dual-quaternion paper and verified Study condition, rigid-transform encoding, antipodal sign selection, DLB normalization and GPU algorithm outline. This verifies source equations, not the completeness of the repository implementation.

Stop-motion microjitter and temporal sample-and-hold are explicitly classified as project-authored implementation conventions. No external paper is attributed to the exact hash recipe or the chosen floor-quantization policy.
